notes: Version 2.7.1 rewords one open direction of the colour-sector paragraph in line with ENI version 2.9. The open direction is the construction of a colour stratum satisfying the premises of ENI Corollary 6, not a derivation of colour confinement from the non-injectivity of the colour projection: where such a stratum exists, the colour projection onto colour-neutral objects is non-injective, a constraint that takes colour neutrality as a premise and does not derive the non-observability of free colour. No other statement is changed.
